letter_sounds.answer_rule: For consonants that can represent more than one sound (i.e., c, g), either answer is acceptable. For vowels, either the short or long sound is accepted (/i/ as in pin or as in pine). Students may have difficulty in eliminating the vowel sound frequently associated with consonants; in these cases either /b/ or /buh/ is accepted as a correct response. During training, enumerators and supervisors should carefully review possible pronunciations of each letter. (For a complete listing of characters and symbols in phonetic alphabets, please see http://www.antimoon.com/misc/phonchart2008.pdf.)

segmentation.scoring: The examiner records the number of correct phonemes as a proportion of total phonemes attempted. This is not a timed segment of the assessment. (tk2009:p32, printed p.25)

lines: My name is Pat.  I live on a farm with my mother, father and brother Sam.
My family is happy. One day Sam planted seeds with father.  A snake bit him!
Mother knew what to do.  She put wet cloths and leaves on his leg.
The next day, Sam was back in the field with father.  We were happy again.

prompts.q: اپنی انگلی کے اشارے سے مجھے بتائیے کہ اس کہانی کا آخری لفظ کونسا ہے؟
prompts.expected: (بچہ کہانی کے آخری لفظ پر انگلی رکھتا ہے "ہے")
